text:
Turn them over,

seize them by the tail (let them squeal, whores),

whip them,

give sugar to the balky ones’ mouths,

blow them up, balloons, prick them,

suck out their blood and marrow,

dry them,

geld them,

trample them, gallant rooster,

wring their necks, cook,

pluck them,

gut them, bull,

ox, drag them,

make them, poet,

make them swallow all their words.

translation.title: Turn Them Over…
translation.editorial_note: This separately lineated witness of “Words” preserves the same reviewed imperatives and its first-line title.
